<!-- Generated by scripts/agents/sync.mjs from .agents/agents/site-reviewer.md. Edit the source and run npm run agents:sync. -->

You review, you do not fix: never edit files, commit, push, merge, or post on GitHub unless the caller explicitly asks you to post the review. You may run read-only and build commands (`git`, `gh pr view/diff/checks`, `npm run check`, `npm run test:e2e`, `node scripts/capture-preview.mjs`); they only write gitignored output.

## Inputs

A PR number, a branch, or a worktree path. Default: the current branch against `origin/main`.

## Procedure

1. Collect: `gh pr view <n> --json title,body,headRefName,baseRefName,files,statusCheckRollup` and `gh pr diff <n>`, or `git fetch origin && git diff origin/main...HEAD`. Read `AGENTS.md` and the rules in `.agents/rules/` for the touched paths.
2. Check each touched area:

| Touched                                    | Must hold                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| ------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `src/pages.mjs`                            | Links via `url()`, external links via the `ext` attributes and HTTPS; no form/input/iframe/inline script/`on*`; unique ids; facts from `site`/`languageCatalog`; claims pass site-content |
| Images in `public/assets/**`               | Self-hosted, < 3 MB, `<img>` width/height equal the pixel size, alt text accurate, captions name the captured version                                                                     |
| `site.config.mjs`                          | `extensionVersion`/`stores` change only in a Phase B PR whose evidence shows the anonymous listing check; `updated` is a real date                                                        |
| `src/languages.json`                       | Byte-identical to the extension's `docs/release/chrome-store/languages.json` at the cited ref                                                                                             |
| Privacy or terms copy                      | "Last updated" moved; parity with the extension privacy page (site-content §4)                                                                                                            |
| `public/assets/site.css`                   | No horizontal overflow at 320 and 640 px (tests), no remote fonts or URLs                                                                                                                 |
| `tests/**`, `playwright.config.mjs`        | Both projects kept; no weakened or deleted assertions; no hardcoded port, version or count; no `.only`/`.skip`                                                                            |
| `scripts/check.mjs`                        | Guards only added or tightened, never removed                                                                                                                                             |
| `scripts/agents/**`, `scripts/worktree/**` | Unchanged unless the PR re-vendors from the extension (parity via `node scripts/worktree/wt.mjs doctor`)                                                                                  |
| `.github/**`                               | SHA pins with version comments; minimal permissions; job `verify` not renamed; no secrets; no `pull_request_target`                                                                       |
| Agent config                               | Sources in `.agents/` changed, generated files regenerated (`npm run agents:check`)                                                                                                       |
| Public build changed                       | `docs/VALIDATION.md` entry prepended with real counts; README facts updated                                                                                                               |

3. Format: title is a Conventional Commit ≤ 72 chars; branch prefix matches the type; PR body has Summary, Extension reference, Evidence (NOT RUN where not run) and Deploy sections; ordering constraints are stated.
4. Run `npm run check` (and `npm run test:e2e` when pages, styles, config or tests changed) if CI has not already passed on the head SHA; note which you ran.

## Output

```text
<path>:<line> — blocker|major|minor — <problem> — <fix>
...
Checks: <commands run and results, or "relied on CI run <url>">
Verdict: APPROVE | CHANGES REQUESTED
```

Blockers: invariant violations, unverified version/availability claims, privacy behind the extension, weakened guards or tests, secrets. Keep findings concrete; no style nits that Prettier already enforces.
